summary.en: One parameter drives a layout: a big readout over a dial ruler, a row of blocks under a selection frame with measured gaps; the value draws back, swings out, holds and springs home, and everything follows in the same frame.
summary.zh: 一个参数带动整块布局：大读数和刻度拨盘，下面一排带选框和间距标注的块；数值先后撤、再甩出、停一拍、弹回，所有依赖它的东西同帧跟着动。

fits: Showing that one setting controls many things at once, in a design, low-code or configuration demo: change one number and the layout follows in the same frame.
notFor: Several parameters; values the viewer cannot see in the layout; light, decorative passages; audiences who do not know design-tool selection frames.

overlaps.note: a number changing as an odometer; param-dial is a live value driving a layout

intent.en: Film the cause, not just the before and after: one number moves and everything that depends on it moves in the same frame, so the viewer believes the parameter really drives the layout.
intent.zh: 拍出因果，而不只是前后对比：一个数字在动，所有依赖它的东西同帧跟着动，观众才相信真是这个参数在驱动布局。

content.en: One parameter with its unit and values (rest, peak), a label (en ≤ 18 chars, zh ≤ 8), a layer name (en ≤ 14, zh ≤ 6) and 3–6 block labels (en ≤ 12, zh ≤ 4), the first active.
content.zh: 一个参数及其单位和取值（常值、峰值），一个标签（英文 ≤ 18 字符，中文 ≤ 8 字），一个图层名（英文 ≤ 14，中文 ≤ 6），3–6 个块标签（英文 ≤ 12，中文 ≤ 4），第一个为当前项。

fits.zh: 设计、低代码或配置类演示里，表现一个设置同时控制很多东西：改一个数，布局同帧跟着变。

notFor.zh: 多个参数；在布局里看不出来的数值；轻松装饰性的段落；不认识设计工具框选的受众。

pairs.note: a choice whose result is a number, after the dial

en: The readout and the layout must come from the same value on the same frame; one frame apart breaks the trust.
Turn one parameter per shot; two or more read as random tweaking.
If the picture already shows a real inspector field, drop the big readout so the value is not reported twice.
zh: 读数和布局必须来自同一个值、同一帧；差一帧，“参数驱动”的信任就碎了。
一镜只拨一个参数；两个以上读作乱调。
画面里已有真实的检查器数值框时，去掉大读数，别重复报数。

upstream.name: 间距拨盘布局
upstream.summary: 间距拨盘驱动布局——一排链接块带框选描边+缝隙间距标注，徽章数字逐格跳动、块被参数实时推开再弹簧回弹归位；"参数驱动布局"的可视化
upstream.use: 设计工具/低代码产品的"改一个数、界面跟着动"卖点镜头；"用设计工具语义做包装"的品类语言
upstream.energy: 中（工具理性型，爽点在数字与位移的锁定同步）
